description: "Equality" by Charles Dudley Warner is an analytical essay written during the late 19th century. This thought-provoking work delves into the philosophical concept of equality, critiquing the modern interpretation which often confuses equality with uniformity, and discusses its implications in various aspects of society, including politics, education, and social structure.
